book.title: Introduction to Christianity
book.author: Pope Benedict XVI
book.thesis: Christianity centers on the fundamental decision that the invisible divine reality supports all visible existence, revealed definitively through Jesus Christ who embodies both the personal and transcendent nature of God as Trinity. This faith requires ongoing conversion and represents humanity's dialogical relationship with God, expressed through the Church community and sustained by the Holy Spirit.
